ticket_shown_to_model.title: Full Outage of Analytics Dashboard - Service Unresponsive / 503 Errors
ticket_shown_to_model.description:
We are reporting a full outage of the Analytics Dashboard in the production US-West environment. The service is completely unresponsive for users. Direct API calls and web interface attempts are returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors.

This affects approximately 77 users and has a moderate business impact as analytics data cannot be accessed. The outage appears to have started recently. We need confirmation of the status and an estimated time to resolution.

parsed.summary: The Analytics Dashboard in the production US-West environment is experiencing a full outage, with users receiving 503 Service Unavailable errors. The cause is currently unknown, but it appears to be related to the reliability and availability of the service.
